title: AlertsArchiveIndex
description: alerts/archive/<YYYY>/<MM>/index.json (docs/alerts.md section 12.3): every record's row and byte span in the month's alerts.jsonl. That networks are sorted and unique, that rows are sorted by id and unique, that a row's network is the position of its id's network, that ended and reason are both null or both set, and that the spans tile the file are the readers' own checks.

archiveSchemaVersion.description: A reader rejects a version above the one it implements.

alerts.description: The month's records, beside the index.

networks.description: The networks the month holds, sorted.

ArchiveRow.description: [id, network (its position in networks), category, level, event, first, ended, reason, offset, length]: category, level and event the alert's, first the record's, ended and reason its ended.time and ended.reason or two nulls, and the byte span of the record's JSON object without the newline.
